page.title: Organisation webhooks

panel.descriptionProject: Subscribers receive a signed POST for each event in this project. Verify X-Annotation-Signature with the secret shown once at creation.
panel.descriptionOrg: Subscribers receive a signed POST for each event in the organisation. Verify X-Annotation-Signature with the secret shown once at creation.
panel.testQueued: Test queued — it goes out on the worker's next tick.

apiKeys.confirmRevoke: Click Revoke again to confirm. A revoked key stops working immediately and cannot be restored.

page.title: API keys
page.description: Keys act as you with the scopes you grant them. Send one as Authorization: Bearer {{example}}. Keys cannot manage other keys.

empty.title: No API keys
empty.message: Create one above to call the API from scripts.

serviceAccounts.heading: Service accounts
serviceAccounts.description: A service account cannot sign in; it acts only through its API keys, with the project roles it is given. Add it to a project from the project's Members panel using its e-mail.

empty.title: No service accounts
empty.message: Create one for a CI job or an integration.

accountKeys.empty: This account has no keys yet.

card.confirmNotice: Deactivating revokes every key this account holds, immediately. The account cannot be reactivated.

page.title: Licence
page.description: A key pasted here is kept next to APP_LICENSE_KEY; the valid key that expires last is in force. A seat is a person who signed in during the last 30 days.
page.removeConfirm: Remove the stored key? The installation falls back to APP_LICENSE_KEY or Community.

edition.communityUsage: {{active}} of 3 people active on the free Community edition.
edition.communityNext: Team adds people (12 €/user/month, or 29 €/month for five plus 12 € per extra user). Business adds single sign-on, SCIM, folder permissions, full audit history and quality control (20 €/user/month).
edition.trialPrivacy: Free, no card and no e-mail. Asks the licence server for a trial key, sending only this installation's id and host. When it ends, the installation returns to Community and keeps all its data.
edition.trialUsed: This installation has had its Business trial. A licence key adds people and the Business features.
edition.trialUntil: Every Business feature, for up to 25 people, until {{date}}. Afterwards the installation returns to Community, for up to three people, and keeps all its data.

badge.label: Business
badge.hint: Part of the Business edition. Start a free trial or add a key on the licence page.

seats.noLimit: {{active}} active — this build enforces no seat limit
seats.communityOfThree: {{active}} of 3 — Community is for up to three people

refresh.loadError: Could not load the refresh status: {{message}}
refresh.heading: Licence refresh
refresh.description: Fetches the renewed key for the licence in force. Sends the licence id, install id, host and number of active users — no names or addresses. {{state}}
refresh.stateNoServer: No licence server is configured; nothing is sent.
refresh.stateDisabled: Switched off; renewed keys have to be pasted by hand.
refresh.stateIdle: Idle: there is no licence key to refresh.

heartbeat.loadError: Could not load the heartbeat preview: {{message}}
heartbeat.heading: Heartbeat
heartbeat.description: On by default; set APP_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false to turn it off. Weekly. Only salted hashes of organisation signals, never names or addresses. {{state}}
heartbeat.stateNoServer: On, but no licence server is set.
heartbeat.withheld: Left out of the fingerprint (kept on this installation, not sent)

seatReport.heading: Seat report
seatReport.description: Active users per month, rebuilt from sign-ins. Send it to the vendor at renewal; the peak over your seats is the overage to true up. Defaults to the last 365 days.
seatReport.locked: The monthly seat report for procurement and true-up is part of the Business edition. The seat count above is always shown.
seatReport.loadError: Could not load the seat report: {{message}}

usageNotices.heading: Usage notices
usageNotices.description: Signs that an account is shared or used by more than one person, from the last {{days}} days. They are worked out here, never sent anywhere, and nothing is blocked. People sharing an account still count as seats.

banner.expiredHostMismatch: The licence key is for {{hosts}}, not the address this installation is reached on.
banner.restricted: {{expired}} Annotation and new tasks are paused until a renewed key is installed; reading and export still work.
banner.graceWarning: {{expired}} Work continues{{until}}; install a renewed key before then.
banner.invalid: The licence key is not valid, so this installation runs as Community (up to three users).
banner.ownerOnly: More than three people are active on the free Community edition, so only the owner can sign in. Deactivate users down to three, or add a Team or Business licence.
banner.trialEnding: The Business trial ends on {{date}}. The installation then returns to the free Community edition, for up to three people.
banner.allSeatsUsed: Every seat is in use, overage included: {{active}} active users for {{seats}} seats. New users cannot sign in until seats are added.
banner.overageAllowed: {{active}} active users for {{seats}} seats. The overage (up to {{limit}}) is allowed and is invoiced at renewal.

security.title: Security
security.description: Two-step sign-in asks for a code from an authenticator app (Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator, 1Password, …) after your password.
security.loadError: Could not load your security settings

mfaRequired.notice: Administrators on this installation must use two-step sign-in. Set up an authenticator app to continue.
mfaRequired.done: Two-step sign-in is on. Save your recovery codes, then sign in again with a code.

mfa.heading: Two-step sign-in
mfa.ssoNotice: You sign in through single sign-on, so two-step sign-in is set up at your identity provider, not here.
mfa.scanInstructions: Scan the code with your app, or open the link on your phone, or type the key.
mfa.qrLabel: QR code for the authenticator app

recoveryCodes.title: Recovery codes — save them now; they are not shown again.
recoveryCodes.hint: Each works once, in place of a code from the app, if you lose your phone.

notifications.heading: Notifications
notifications.description: Mentions, replies to your comments and review verdicts always appear under the bell. You also get them by e-mail when your administrator has set up e-mail.

personalData.heading: Your data
personalData.description: Download everything this installation holds about you: profile, project memberships, comments, annotation history, tasks, notifications and sign-in records. To have your account erased, ask an administrator.

mlPlatforms.heading: ML platforms
mlPlatforms.intro: MLflow tracking servers, Databricks and Azure ML workspaces. Snapshots are published to them as MLflow runs, trained versions are imported from them, and a Databricks job can run a retrain. Nothing is copied: runs point at the snapshot in your storage.

form.name: Name
form.secretHint: The secret reference names where the credential lives (env:NAME, file:/path, azurekeyvault://vault/name, …); the credential itself is never stored or shown. A basic-auth secret is user:password.
form.uiUrl: UI URL (optional, if not the tracking URI)

import.aria: Import a model version from MLflow
import.noPlatforms: Register an ML platform below first.
import.hint: Metrics, parameters and a link to the run are stored with the version; the snapshot comes from the run's annotation.snapshot_* tags or its snapshot dataset input.
